reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: POST handler is a public Next.js App Router route endpoint (exported function), public API exception applies — external OAuth clients call it directly. Gate 2: No trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; entry point is public HTTP, no trusted-source shield. Gate 3: src/app/oauth/ is explicitly in-scope. An attacker can trigger this via POST /oauth/token by firing two concurrent requests with identical code, client_id, client_secret, code_verifier, and redirect_uri — both requests read the authorization code before either delete_authorization_code RPC commits (PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED allows concurrent reads of the same row), causing the server to issue two independent 30-day access tokens from a single authorization code. Severity remains High: concrete RFC 6749 §10.5 violation with reproducible race window, but attacker must already possess a valid authorization code (own client or interception), which limits blast radius compared to Critical.
